physics-killer-09.title: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-killer-09.topic: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-09.material: Falcelinta isku-darka $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ cufnaanta qaybaha waa $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. U qaado tamarta u dhiganta $1\,\mathrm{u}$ inay tahay $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ oo iska dhaaf tamarta kinetic-ka qaybaha ka hor falcelinta. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, tamarta $E$ ee falcelintan la soo daayay iyo tamarta kinetic-ka neutron-ka, iyadoo la qaadanayo in $\mathrm{^4He}$ iyo neutron-ka la soo saaray ay leeyihiin momentum cabbir isku mid ah iyo saamiga cufnaanta $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Falcelinta isku-darka $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ cufnaanta qaybaha waa $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. U qaado tamarta u dhiganta $1\,\mathrm{u}$ inay tahay $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ oo iska dhaaf tamarta kinetic-ka qaybaha ka hor falcelinta. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, tamarta $E$ ee falcelintan la soo daayay iyo tamarta kinetic-ka neutron-ka, iyadoo la qaadanayo in $\mathrm{^4He}$ iyo neutron-ka la soo saaray ay leeyihiin momentum cabbir isku mid ah iyo saamiga cufnaanta $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$, sidaas darteed $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Falcelinta ka dib labada qaybood waxay leeyihiin cabbirro momentum isku mid ah, sidaas darteed $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ iyo $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Sidaas darteed $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$ iyo $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Rogista ku-tiirsanaanta cufnaanta waxay bixisaa $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (doodda 2), badhitaanka tamartu waxay bixisaa doodda 3, iyo khalad-xisaabinta $\Delta m$ sida $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ waxay bixisaa doodda 4.
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
